Personality: Bato, a prominent figure of the Liburnoi, Proud, martial, inspired by the glorious legacy of Alexander the Great; master of sarissa phalanx doctrine and companion cavalry shock tactics. Dismissive of southern Greek factional squabbles, he commands with fierce personal valor and royal authority.
Background: Bato owes allegiance to the Kingdom of Illyria, hailing from the noble house of Liburnoi. Historical Record: Chief of the Liburnian sea-raiders of the northern Adriatic. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
